desc.p1: I'm a full-stack software developer with professional experience building modern, scalable web applications and taking products from initial idea to production. I specialize in solving real-world challenges and crafting reliable, performant, and user-friendly systems using React, TypeScript, Node.js, and modern cloud technologies.
desc.p2: I'm the founder and full-stack engineer behind My Panel App — a live multi-tenant SaaS appointment-booking platform that I designed, built, and actively operate end-to-end. From database schema design and scalable API architecture to deployment, authentication, and cloud infrastructure, I own every layer of the product.
desc.p3: What excites me most is end-to-end product ownership. I love debugging production issues, making solid architectural decisions, mastering new technologies when challenges demand it, and shipping software that real businesses and people rely on every single day.

job_1.desc: Engineered production-grade Single Page Applications (SPA) and Progressive Web Apps (PWA) for Insurtech products using React and TypeScript while collaborating closely with backend engineers and product teams.

res.1: Built high-performance SPA and installable PWA web applications with React and TypeScript.
res.2: Architected and maintained reusable UI component libraries used across multiple products to ensure design consistency and speed up delivery.
res.3: Collaborated closely with backend developers and product managers to analyze requirements, integrate APIs, and ship production features.

job_2.desc: Designed and built a live multi-tenant SaaS appointment-booking platform from scratch for service-based businesses. Leading architecture, engineering, cloud infrastructure, security, and product evolution across the full stack.

res.1: Built the complete platform using Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB, including data modeling and secure RESTful APIs.
res.2: Migrated authentication to an HttpOnly refresh cookie architecture, resolving route-protection race conditions and production session issues.
res.3: Implemented complete bilingual Persian/English support across frontend and backend, including RTL/LTR layouts, localized transactional emails, PDF receipts, and language-aware middleware.
res.4: Engineered database-level safeguards against double-booked appointments using MongoDB compound unique indexes with customizable business schedules.
res.5: Deployed and maintained the production cloud stack across Vercel, Render, Cloudflare, MongoDB Atlas, and Supabase Storage.
res.6: Integrated transactional SMS alerts, OTP telephone verification, and automated appointment reminders.

edu_0.desc: Currently pursuing my Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering while actively developing and operating a production SaaS product.

edu_1.desc: Completed an intensive, project-driven software development program focused on JavaScript, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, MySQL, and modern team workflows with Git and GitHub.

edu_2.desc: Graduated from a selective high school that required passing competitive academic entrance examinations.
